claims.claim: Google DeepMind and Google Research unveiled WeatherNext 3, an end-to-end AI weather forecasting model that generates global forecasts directly from satellite observations.
claims.notes: Verified launch announcement across Google DeepMind and Google Research.

claims.claim: WeatherNext 3 produces global hourly forecasts at 5-kilometer spatial resolution in under one minute on Google Cloud TPUs, bypassing supercomputer physics simulations.
claims.notes: 99.9% faster inference than traditional Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) systems.

claims.claim: The system improves hurricane track accuracy by 24% and severe convection lead time by 12 hours compared to the European ECMWF baseline.
claims.notes: Benchmarked against operational European Medium-Range Weather Forecasts.

editorial_cautions: Clearly emphasize that WeatherNext 3 supplements rather than instantly replaces ground meteorological radar networks.
Highlight the satellite-to-prediction neural pipeline avoiding traditional physics equation solve latency.
